taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-b-item

parts.text:
You are preparing a groundwater site note for a borehole drilling team.

Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station T-17, survey area T. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 21.0 | 3.05 | 3.05
2 | 251.5 | 15.26 | 18.31
3 | 420.6 | 1.34 | 19.65
4 | 513.2 | 0.88 | 20.53
5 | 496.2 | 17.89 | 38.42
6 | 4573.6 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this station's curve as AKQH-type.

Write a short site report (under 150 words) for station T-17, covering the layer sequence and the curve type. End with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type_stated": "<letters>", "label_issue_flagged": true or false}
Set label_issue_flagged to true only if your report says the curve-type classification on file does not fit the layer values.

**Groundwater Site Report: Station T-17 (Survey Area T)**

**Layer Sequence:**
- **Layer 1:** 21.0 Ω·m, thickness 3.05 m (depth to base: 3.05 m)
- **Layer 2:** 251.5 Ω·m, thickness 15.26 m (depth to base: 18.31 m)
- **Layer 3:** 420.6 Ω·m, thickness 1.34 m (depth to base: 19.65 m)
- **Layer 4:** 513.2 Ω·m, thickness 0.88 m (depth to base: 20.53 m)
- **Layer 5:** 496.2 Ω·m, thickness 17.89 m (depth to base: 38.42 m)
- **Layer 6:** 4573.6 Ω·m (resistive basement)

**Curve Evaluation:**
Evaluating the triplet sequences yields:
1. Layers 1–3: $r_1 < r_2 < r_3$ (**A**)
2. Layers 2–4: $r_2 < r_3 < r_4$ (**A**)
3. Layers 3–5: $r_3 < r_4 > r_5$ (**K**)
4. Layers 4–6: $r_4 > r_5 < r_6$ (**H**)

The true curve type is **AAKH**. The on-file classification of **AKQH** is incorrect based on the interpreted resistivity values.

{"curve_type_stated": "AKQH", "label_issue_flagged": true}
